title: 第7章 入通脉境第8章 打通暗脉
content_zh:
王后要废江若尘为庶人，发配燕山的命令一出，令在场所有人都有些惊讶。
因为江若尘虽然没有让武魂钟发出声音，可说到底，他也算觉醒了武魂。
都不用宗人府商议，镇南王点头，就直接废为庶人，发配燕山……这多少有点不公了。
可惊讶归惊讶，根本就不会有人会为了“废物”
去跟王后求情的。
更多的还是幸灾乐祸。
“哈哈，发配燕山，真是开创了先河啊，想我镇南王朝，还从未有王子发配过燕山吧？”
江立毫不顾忌的嘲笑道。
“确实是，这个废物也算是敢为天下先了。”
九王子嘴角微微上扬。
“王后！
尘儿的武魂虽然没有品级……可他终归是觉醒了，怎么能直接发配燕山？请王后开恩，给尘儿一个机会吧！
说不定日后，尘儿也能有所作为。”
唯有婉妃着急的站出，为江若尘争取。
王后却冷若冰霜的大声斥责道：“没有品级，也能称作武魂？废武魂又能有什么作为！
江若尘为王室蒙羞，为大王蒙羞！
必须发配燕山，不准再议，否则，王鞭加身！”
王鞭二字，几乎让所有人都打了一个寒颤。
可情急的婉妃却全然不顾，流着泪就要跪下，继续求情。
因为一旦发配燕山，江若尘不仅失去王子身份，更不会有任何的资源，还要面临生命危险。

她做母亲的，哪怕是死，也绝对不会眼睁睁的看着自己的孩子，被发配至燕山。
就在她即将要跪下求情时，江若尘却不知何时，来到了她的身旁拉住了她：“娘亲，不必哀求！”
江若尘再神情坚毅的看向王妃：“江若尘领旨！”
“哼，你倒是有点骨气，既然领旨，那明日就发配燕山！”
王后冷哼一声，甩袖离去。
秦琪跟随离开时路过江若尘的身边，还嫌恶的瞪了江若尘一眼，好似在看一条无比恶心的臭虫。
江若尘没有愤怒，只有为前身深深的感到不值。
一味的追求付出，换来的只有恶心厌恶的眼神，哪怕一丝可怜同情的情绪都没有，这多么的可悲啊？
王后离场，仪式结束，江若尘也搀扶着婉妃，返回了紫极偏殿。
“尘儿，你别担心，娘亲一定不会让你去燕山的，我去求你父王开恩！”
回到偏殿的婉妃泪眼朦胧，着急的想要去求镇南王。
content_en:
The queen wanted to depose Jiang Ruochen as a commoner and send him to Yanshan, which surprised everyone present.
Because although Jiang Ruochen didn't make the Wuhun Bell sound, in the final analysis, he had awakened the Wuhun.
Without any discussion from the clan government, King Zhennan nodded and immediately deposed him as a commoner and sent him to Yanshan... This was somewhat unfair.
But I'm surprised, no one would do it for "trash"
Go and plead with the queen.
Most of them are gloating over misfortune.
"Haha, being assigned to Yanshan is really a precedent. I think in our Zhennan Dynasty, no prince has ever been assigned to Yanshan, right?"
Jiang Li laughed without hesitation.
"Indeed, this waste can be considered as daring to be the first in the world."
The corners of the Ninth Prince's mouth raised slightly.
"Queen!
Although Chen'er's martial spirit has no level...but he has finally awakened, how can he be assigned to Yanshan directly? Please be kind to the queen and give Chen'er a chance!
Maybe Chen'er can make a difference in the future. "
Only Concubine Wan stood up anxiously and fought for Jiang Ruochen.
However, the queen rebuked loudly and coldly: "How can it be called a martial spirit without a grade? What can a useless martial spirit do?
Jiang Ruochen was embarrassed for the royal family and humiliated for the king!
He must be assigned to Yanshan, and no further discussion is allowed, otherwise, he will be punished by the king's whip! "
The word "wang whip" almost made everyone shiver.
But the anxious Concubine Wan didn't care at all. She was about to kneel down in tears and continue to plead for mercy.
Because once he is sent to Yanshan, Jiang Ruochen will not only lose his status as a prince, he will not have any resources, and his life will be in danger.
As a mother, even if she died, she would never watch her child being sent to Yanshan.
Just when she was about to kneel down and beg for mercy, Jiang Ruochen came to her side and held her back at some unknown moment: "Mother, there is no need to beg!"
Jiang Ruochen looked at the princess with a determined expression: "Jiang Ruochen accepts the order!"
"Hmph, you do have some backbone. Since you have accepted the decree, you will be sent to Yanshan tomorrow!"
The queen snorted coldly, tossed her sleeves and left.
Qin Qi passed by Jiang Ruochen as she followed him away, and glared at Jiang Ruochen in disgust, as if she was looking at an extremely disgusting bed bug.
Jiang Ruochen was not angry, but felt deeply worthless for his predecessor.
Blindly pursuing dedication only gets disgusting and disgusted eyes, without even a trace of pity and sympathy. How sad is this?
The queen left and the ceremony ended. Jiang Ruochen also supported Concubine Wan and returned to the Ziji side hall.
"Chen'er, don't worry, mother will definitely not let you go to Yanshan. I will go and beg your father for mercy!"
Concubine Wan, who returned to the side hall, had tears in her eyes and wanted to beg King Zhennan anxiously.
